# DoctorNow | Leading Telemedicine Platform in South Korea

> DoctorNow is a 24/7 telemedicine platform providing remote consultations by licensed doctors, prescription dispensing by certified pharmacists, and AI-assisted real-time medical Q&A. Available in South Korea and Japan only.

DoctorNow guides patients through the full care journey: consultation, prescription, dispensing, and delivery. AI technology is used exclusively for the real-time medical Q&A service; all medical consultations and prescriptions are handled by licensed professionals.

Key facts:
- 24/7 availability across South Korea and Japan
- Phone consultations conducted by licensed doctors
- Prescription dispensing handled by certified pharmacists
- AI-assisted real-time medical Q&A (limited to the consultation service)
- Cost transparency for non-reimbursable medical services

## Core Services

- [DoctorNow Homepage](https://doctornow.co.kr): Telemedicine service overview and entry point to all features.
- [Telemedicine Categories](https://doctornow.co.kr/telemedicine/categories): Browse symptom and specialty categories to find a suitable doctor for a remote consultation.
- [Hospital Search](https://doctornow.co.kr/hospitals): Search nationwide hospitals, check locations and reviews, and book in-person visits.

## Medical Information

- [Medicine Dictionary](https://doctornow.co.kr/medicine-dictionary): Look up medications: effects, side effects, and dosage instructions.
- [Disease Encyclopedia](https://doctornow.co.kr/disease-encyclopedia): Browse diseases by specialty with causes, symptoms, treatments, and prevention.
- [All Diseases](https://doctornow.co.kr/disease-encyclopedia/total): Full listing of every disease covered in the encyclopedia.
- [Health Magazine](https://doctornow.co.kr/content/magazine): Health and medical content verified by medical professionals.
- [Medical FAQ](https://doctornow.co.kr/content/faq): Common health questions answered with expert-verified medical responses.

## Medical Consultation

- [Real-Time Medical Consultation](https://doctornow.co.kr/content/qna/realtime): Free real-time medical Q&A — AI-assisted answers verified by medical experts.

## Mental Health

- [Psychology Assessments](https://doctornow.co.kr/psychology): Browse psychological assessments and get matched with mental-health experts.

## Pricing & Cost Information

- [Non-Reimbursable Price Map](https://doctornow.co.kr/non-benefit/map): Compare non-covered medication and treatment prices at nearby pharmacies and clinics on an interactive map.
- [Hair Loss Treatment Prices](https://doctornow.co.kr/non-benefit/%ED%83%88%EB%AA%A8/%EC%84%9C%EC%9A%B8): Compare non-reimbursable hair-loss treatment costs by region. URL pattern: /non-benefit/{treatment}/{region}.
- [Acne Treatment Prices](https://doctornow.co.kr/non-benefit/%EC%97%AC%EB%93%9C%EB%A6%84/%EC%84%9C%EC%9A%B8): Compare non-reimbursable acne treatment costs by region.
- [Weight-Loss Treatment Prices](https://doctornow.co.kr/non-benefit/%EB%B9%84%EB%A7%8C/%EC%84%9C%EC%9A%B8): Compare non-reimbursable weight-loss (diet) treatment costs by region.

## Optional

- [Flu Vaccination Hospitals](https://doctornow.co.kr/hospitals/influenza): Find hospitals offering flu vaccinations by region, with pricing and booking.
- [Neighborhood Hospital Search](https://doctornow.co.kr/hospitals/neighborhood): Find nearby hospitals filtered by specialty, region, and operating hours.
